title: Missing external dependency: no browser installed
context: The repository has Playwright specs, but no browser binary is available in this environment.
reasoning_notes: A missing capability must degrade the plan honestly: browser categories become BLOCKED, never silently skipped and never simulated.
The engine must not report a browser failure as a product defect.

Calibration note: the engine returns existing-other-tooling. The factor set contains nothing that names WHICH framework the repository uses, so the matrix cannot distinguish C from E -- that choice comes from the repository profile, not from these factors. The assertion that matters here is 'run what already exists, write nothing new', so both are accepted.
not_covered: Which existing browser framework to invoke. That comes from the repository profile, not the decision matrix.
